name: Boku no Satori: Aki no Datenshi Hen
original_name: 僕の悟リ 秋の堕天使編
source:
After summer comes the fall and my ordinary life resumes.
I happen see a young girl stealing.
First I scold her, then I toy with her sensitive body.
The punishment grows in tandem with the girl's seeming desire for it.

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE185690.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
夏天过后，秋天来临，我又开始了平凡的生活。
我碰巧看到一个年轻女孩偷东西。
我先骂她，然后玩弄她敏感的身体。
惩罚随着女孩表面上对惩罚的渴望而增加。

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE185690.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
